newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Senate approves petrochemical selloff.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Senate approves petrochemical selloff.

text.p: The Mexican Senate late on Tuesday approved the government's revised plan to sell off a minority position in the nation's petrochemical industry, television news programme 24 Horas said.
Last week the lower house of Congress, the Chamber of Deputies, approved the scheme for the sale of state-owned petrochemical plants.
The ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party controls both legislative houses.
Earlier this month the government decided to sell a 49 percent stake of the nation's 61 petrochemical plants, instead of the 100 percent as earlier planned.
